verdict.summary: Reject: observe_merge releases its live-gate transaction before journal.observe acquires a separate write transaction. That transaction can wait five seconds and never rechecks deadline, cancellation, or barrier. Expiration or cancellation in this interval can therefore still record confirmed/awaiting_main. Validate these gates inside the transaction recording confirmation and add a regression covering delayed acquisition/cancellation. Candidate and pinned instruction hashes match; 11 independent pure tests passed; inspected Root's 26-test successful capture. Controller/CLI/postmerge completion excluded as explicitly outside scope.
